item.name: 02 Individual Owner
item.description: Individual Owner (individual-owner-service). Frontend requests go through the gateway with {{individual_owner_token}}; _Internal and _Admin requests call the service directly with a service JWT ({{service_token}}). Implemented: Section 5 account security (Frontend, _Admin) and the Sections 6–13 domain API generated from the route registry (profile, banking & tax, properties, ownership & verification and later contexts). Features whose dependency is not configured answer 503 FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE.
